name: users
purpose: One global identity reused across all organizations; credentials and roles live separately.

columns.name: email
columns.purpose: Canonical lower-case email; application validates format.

columns.name: updated_at
columns.purpose: Last mutation instant; application updates this field.

columns.name: deleted_at
columns.purpose: Soft deletion instant; history and foreign keys remain intact.

checks: email = lower(btrim(email)) AND position('@' IN email) > 1

name: user_auth_methods
purpose: Future-compatible authentication method bindings; no plaintext credentials.

columns.name: provider
columns.purpose: Allowed values: EMAIL_OTP, PASSWORD, GOOGLE, APPLE, PHONE_OTP.

columns.name: updated_at
columns.purpose: Last mutation instant; application updates this field.

checks: (provider = 'PASSWORD' AND password_hash IS NOT NULL) OR (provider <> 'PASSWORD' AND password_hash IS NULL)

name: user_sessions
purpose: Revocable opaque login sessions. Store only a keyed digest of the bearer token.

name: otp_challenges
purpose: Short-lived, single-use OTP challenges. Keyed hashes prevent offline guessing of small code spaces.
checks: attempts >= 0 AND max_attempts BETWEEN 1 AND 10 AND attempts <= max_attempts

name: platform_admins
purpose: Explicit global administrator grants; granting organization ownership never grants platform access.

name: organizations
purpose: Shared business root for both individual teachers and multi-instructor studios.

columns.name: notes

columns.name: updated_at

name: organization_settings

columns.name: organization_id

columns.name: updated_at

name: plans
purpose: Database-driven platform subscription catalogue; amounts are integer minor currency units.

columns.name: updated_at
columns.purpose: Last mutation instant; application updates this field.

name: plan_features
purpose: Typed entitlements read by one centralized authorization/usage service.

columns.name: updated_at
columns.purpose: Last mutation instant; application updates this field.

checks: (value_type = 'BOOLEAN' AND boolean_value IS NOT NULL AND integer_value IS NULL AND text_value IS NULL) OR (value_type = 'INTEGER' AND boolean_value IS NULL AND integer_value IS NOT NULL AND text_value IS NULL) OR (value_type = 'TEXT' AND boolean_value IS NULL AND integer_value IS NULL AND text_value IS NOT NULL)

name: organization_subscriptions
purpose: Current platform subscription per tenant; historical transitions remain in organization_subscription_history and audit logs. Student purchases never use this table.

columns.name: organization_id
columns.purpose: Owning tenant; always filter tenant reads by this column.

columns.name: status
columns.purpose: Allowed values: TRIAL, ACTIVE, PAST_DUE, EXPIRED, CANCELLED, SUSPENDED.

columns.name: updated_at
columns.purpose: Last mutation instant; application updates this field.

checks: ends_at IS NULL OR ends_at > starts_at
(trial_starts_at IS NULL AND trial_ends_at IS NULL) OR (trial_starts_at IS NOT NULL AND trial_ends_at IS NOT NULL AND trial_ends_at > trial_starts_at)
status <> 'TRIAL' OR (trial_starts_at IS NOT NULL AND trial_ends_at IS NOT NULL)
(provider_subscription_id IS NULL) OR (payment_provider IS NOT NULL)

name: organization_subscription_history
purpose: Append-only subscription transition snapshots; preserve past plan periods, amounts and effective access.

columns.name: organization_id
columns.purpose: Owning tenant; always filter tenant reads by this column.

checks: ends_at IS NULL OR ends_at > starts_at

name: media_assets

name: sessions
purpose: Sellable session or program; actual dated classes are class_occurrences.

columns.name: organization_id
columns.purpose: Owning tenant; always filter tenant reads by this column.

columns.name: session_type
columns.purpose: Allowed values: GROUP, ONE_TO_ONE, WORKSHOP, PROGRAM.

columns.name: status
columns.purpose: Allowed values: DRAFT, ACTIVE, PAUSED, ARCHIVED.

columns.name: updated_at
columns.purpose: Last mutation instant; application updates this field.

columns.name: deleted_at
columns.purpose: Soft deletion instant; history and foreign keys remain intact.

checks: minimum_age IS NULL OR minimum_age BETWEEN 0 AND 150
maximum_age IS NULL OR maximum_age BETWEEN 0 AND 150
minimum_age IS NULL OR maximum_age IS NULL OR maximum_age >= minimum_age

name: session_instructors
purpose: Staff assignment with primary, secondary or substitute responsibilities.

columns.name: organization_id
columns.purpose: Owning tenant; always filter tenant reads by this column.

columns.name: updated_at
columns.purpose: Last mutation instant; application updates this field.

name: session_pricing
purpose: Versionable access/pricing options; purchased values are copied into order items and enrollments.

columns.name: organization_id
columns.purpose: Owning tenant; always filter tenant reads by this column.

columns.name: pricing_type
columns.purpose: Allowed values: ONE_TIME, MONTHLY, PACKAGE, PER_SESSION, CUSTOM.

columns.name: access_type
columns.purpose: Allowed values: DATE_RANGE, NUMBER_OF_CLASSES, PROGRAM_DURATION, UNLIMITED.

columns.name: updated_at
columns.purpose: Last mutation instant; application updates this field.

checks: (access_type = 'DATE_RANGE' AND access_duration_days IS NOT NULL AND included_class_count IS NULL) OR (access_type = 'NUMBER_OF_CLASSES' AND included_class_count IS NOT NULL AND access_duration_days IS NULL) OR (access_type IN ('PROGRAM_DURATION','UNLIMITED') AND access_duration_days IS NULL AND included_class_count IS NULL)

name: session_requirements
purpose: Structured public prerequisites, equipment, preparation and notes.

columns.name: organization_id
columns.purpose: Owning tenant; always filter tenant reads by this column.

columns.name: requirement_type
columns.purpose: Allowed values: PREREQUISITE, EQUIPMENT, PREPARATION, NOTE.

columns.name: updated_at
columns.purpose: Last mutation instant; application updates this field.

name: session_schedule_rules
purpose: Finite or open-ended weekly/local rules expanded only over a bounded rolling horizon. Local wall times intentionally use TIME and DATE.

columns.name: organization_id
columns.purpose: Owning tenant; always filter tenant reads by this column.

columns.name: day_of_week
columns.purpose: ISO weekday 1=Monday to 7=Sunday for WEEKLY rules.

columns.name: end_day_offset
columns.purpose: Day offset for overnight classes (0 = same day, 1 = overnight).

columns.name: updated_at
columns.purpose: Last mutation instant; application updates this field.

checks: (recurrence_type = 'WEEKLY' AND day_of_week IS NOT NULL AND day_of_week BETWEEN 1 AND 7) OR (recurrence_type = 'ONE_TIME' AND day_of_week IS NULL)
(end_day_offset = 0 AND end_time > start_time) OR (end_day_offset = 1 AND end_time <= start_time)
effective_until IS NULL OR effective_until >= effective_from

columns.name: status

name: session_enrollments
purpose: Purchased access grant; each order item activates at most once. Renewal creates another grant and preserves prior payment history.

columns.name: organization_id
columns.purpose: Owning tenant; always filter tenant reads by this column.

columns.name: status
columns.purpose: Allowed values: PENDING, ACTIVE, PAUSED, EXPIRED, CANCELLED, COMPLETED.

columns.name: access_type
columns.purpose: Allowed values: DATE_RANGE, NUMBER_OF_CLASSES, PROGRAM_DURATION, UNLIMITED.

columns.name: updated_at
columns.purpose: Last mutation instant; application updates this field.

checks: access_ends_at IS NULL OR access_ends_at > access_starts_at

(access_type = 'NUMBER_OF_CLASSES' AND included_class_count IS NOT NULL AND remaining_class_count IS NOT NULL AND included_class_count > 0 AND remaining_class_count BETWEEN 0 AND included_class_count) OR (access_type <> 'NUMBER_OF_CLASSES' AND included_class_count IS NULL AND remaining_class_count IS NULL)
access_type NOT IN ('DATE_RANGE','PROGRAM_DURATION') OR access_ends_at IS NOT NULL

published_website_type IS NULL OR published_website_type IN ('DEFAULT','ADVANCED')
status <> 'PUBLISHED' OR (published_at IS NOT NULL AND published_configuration IS NOT NULL AND published_website_type IS NOT NULL)

status <> 'PROCESSING' OR (locked_at IS NOT NULL AND locked_by IS NOT NULL)
